breakdown.description: The prompt describes a turbulent flow but sets the inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero. This is physically incorrect and will prevent turbulence from developing correctly from the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that setting inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero was physically incorrect for a turbulent flow. It replaced the incorrect zero values with physically meaningful, non-zero values calculated from a specified turbulence intensity (I = 0.05) and mixing length (L = 0.005 m), resulting in k = 1.5 m^2/s^2 and omega = 447.2 1/s at the inlet.
